prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Make a revised production-oriented design mockup of 多多打卡, a native iPhone children's habit app. OUTPUT EXACTLY ONE VERY TALL CONTINUOUS VERTICAL IMAGE showing the COMPLETE scrolling homepage, all 17 tasks in all four sections. This is a full-page scroll capture at normal iPhone content width, not a landscape board, not multiple screens. Target width 1024 px and approximately 7600–8200 px height, or the tallest practical resolution preserving all content. Increase canvas height instead of compressing the cards. The image must end with the native tab bar after all sections.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1: authoritative layout/content/style reference, especially the LEFT phone labelled 首页·双列. Use its exact hero composition, star journey style, individual task card anatomy and native controls. The middle phone supplies completed and running states. IGNORE the right phone's single-column arrangement.
Image 2: previous decorative section treatment. Retain ONLY the four colorful toy-space-base section headers and their rounded dimensional frames. Discard its five-phone presentation, external sky backdrop and all-page cloud wallpaper.

CANVAS / DEVICE:
One full-width iPhone screen long screenshot, optional extremely thin side bezel, no outside margins, no desktop/presentation background, no title above the phone, no five-phone lineup, no device sitting in a scene. Standard iPhone native status bar and navigation at very top only, normal content width of 390 logical points. Native centered title 多多打卡, info at left, parent shield at right. Flat very pale iOS grouped background (#F3F4FA) throughout the scroll page. NO decorative overall sky, clouds, stars or planets OUTSIDE hero, journey and group-header illustrations. Bottom native white/translucent Tab bar once at very end: 今日打卡 selected blue-purple, 打卡统计 and 积分消耗 gray, standard SF-symbol-like icons, home indicator. Keep safe areas and native iOS typography.

WIDTHS / SPACING:
Match Image 1 left phone's content scale and margins. Use 12pt outer horizontal margins, group width366pt, inner padding8pt, equal task card columns169pt separated12pt. All four sections strictly TWO COLUMNS. 18pt vertical gap BETWEEN EVERY ROW of task cards, clear breathing room. 24pt separation between sections. Cards approximately180–195pt tall, big centered illustrations and legible text, no crowding. Three odd final cards 睡觉 / 阅读 / 自己穿衣 remain LEFT HALF-WIDTH only with empty right grid space; never full-width or stretched. Do not squeeze page vertically to fit a conventional screen height. Extend the image!

TOP CONTENT:
Copy the reference LEFT phone's hero: navy native headline 今天也要 / 闪闪发光！ at upper left, smiling panda astronaut and orange-white rocket at right, lilac moon ground, white inset fuel display at lower left showing 6 / 13 and 再得7分，飞船就能出发啦！. Keep its illustration confined to this hero rectangle.
Immediately below hero: white native metric strip, 7 今日自评, 6 有效打卡, 0 奖励分, shield 家长确认.
Journey panel must use precisely Image 1 LEFT PHONE style and composition: white rounded card, small earth icon before 我的星际旅程, 本月 6 / 50 at upper right with chevron, subtitle 每50分解锁星球. Lower half: small ascending rocket at far left and dotted blue curved route through four cute textured actual solar-system planets 水星 金星 地球 火星. Progress 6 / 50 under first planet, other three have tiny lock badges and 未解锁. Sparse tiny stars inside the panel only. Keep it airy and compact; do not use the simplified 4-planet plain row from previous Image 2.

FOUR DECORATIVE SECTION SHELLS:
Retain Image 2 toy-like low-profile domes, telescope, plants and dimensional colored rounded frame, with clear title ribbon and compact count. All decorations remain within group width and above cards, never overlapping task contents.
1 orange #FF8D28 energy: orange utensil dome and small rover; title 能量补给站, count 2 / 5.
2 lavender #B0A0FF knowledge: telescope/books and observatory dome; title 知识探索站, count 1 / 3.
3 cyan #00D2E0 life: cyan living domes/star windows and mint shrubs; title 生活空间站, count 3 / 5.
4 rose #FF375F courage: heart/star dome and tiny flag outpost; title 勇气成长站, count 0 / 4.
Interiors subtle pale tint. Frame thin dimensional outline, not massive borders.

INDIVIDUAL CARD ANATOMY -- MATCH IMAGE 1 LEFT PHONE EXACTLY:
First line native black semibold TASK TITLE followed by small gold star and orange +POINTS, on the same top row. Large standalone soft 3D clay task illustration centered BELOW that text. Bottom content: a small blue timer icon with time if applicable, then status or a full-width colored native rounded control. Keep all card content aligned left like Image 1. Same clean generous card padding, consistent baseline/grid spacing.
Completed cards: pale mint-white surface, subtle semitransparent mint circular approval stamp in upper right, green check circle and 已完成 near bottom (NO active button).
Running card: standard light surface, blue timer icon and 12:36 below artwork, purple button 结束.
Not-started timed cards: small timer and duration, filled section-color 开始 button.
Not-started single tasks: section-color 打卡 button.
Pending hygiene card: gentle warm-cream surface and amber 待确认 button, no stamp.
Locked promptness: muted gray artwork/text, small lock and gray disabled 尚未解锁 button; detail 三餐、作业后解锁.
NO extra top labels 未打卡/计时中/已打卡. Never put time or controls over artwork. Use the reference's concise copy. No repeated large descriptions.

EXACT FULL TASK GRID AND STATES (all 17, each exactly once):
ENERGY -- 3 rows:
row1 left 起床 ★+1, sun+tiny blue bed illustration, timer 07:12, green 已完成 + stamp.
row1 right 吃早饭 ★+1, breakfast bowl/toast/milk illustration, timer 25:11 / 30, green 已完成 + stamp.
row2 left 吃午饭 ★+1, rice and vegetables bowl, timer 30分钟, orange 开始.
row2 right 吃晚饭 ★+1, chicken dinner plate, timer 30分钟, orange 开始.
row3 left 睡觉 ★+1, crescent moon and sleeping panda, small timer 晚上9:30, orange 打卡. right EMPTY.

KNOWLEDGE -- 2 rows:
row1 left 认真听讲 ★+2, blue-purple headphones and books, green 已完成 + stamp.
row1 right 写作业 ★+2, orange pencil and purple notebook, blue timer 12:36, purple 结束.
row2 left 阅读 ★+2, stacked blue-purple books, timer 至少15分钟, purple 开始. right EMPTY.

LIFE -- 3 rows:
row1 left 收拾玩具 ★+1, basket with bear/blocks, green 已完成 + stamp.
row1 right 打扫卫生 ★+1, broom and little sparkle, cyan 打卡.
row2 left 洗漱 ★+1, toothbrush cup and duck, timer 晚上9:00, cyan 打卡.
row2 right 干净卫生 ★+1, folded towels and soap, amber 待确认.
row3 left 自己穿衣 ★+1, neatly folded blue clothes, green 已完成 + stamp. right EMPTY.

COURAGE -- 2 rows, NEVER SINGLE COLUMN:
row1 left 乖巧听话 ★+2, panda hugging pink heart, rose 打卡.
row1 right 不发脾气 ★+2, calm seated panda with leaves, rose 打卡.
row2 left 做事不拖拉 ★+2, muted lavender lightning, 三餐、作业后解锁, gray lock 尚未解锁.
row2 right 诚实守信 ★+1, pink shield with white check, rose 打卡.

Finish with small unobtrusive 每天一点点，成长看得见。 above native bottom tab bar.
Accuracy priorities: ONE long image > all17 tasks and four complete groups > fixed two-column card order and 18pt row gaps > correct completed/running/locked states > exact journey style > clear readable Chinese. Do not omit any task or section. No mockup board, no text annotations or arrows outside UI, no ambient full-page wallpaper, no decorative extra games, no invented controls.
